title: Smooth 4D Poincare Conjecture
description: Every homotopy 4-sphere is diffeomorphic to the standard 4-sphere.

title: Slice-Ribbon Conjecture
description: Every slice knot in three-dimensional space is actually a ribbon knot.

title: Volume Conjecture
description: Asymptotic behavior of colored Jones polynomials relates to knot complement hyperbolic volume.

title: Unknotting Problem in P
description: Does a polynomial-time algorithm exist to determine if a knot is trivial.

title: 11/8 Conjecture
description: Bounds the betti numbers and signature of smooth spin 4-manifolds.

title: Whitehead Conjecture
description: Every subcomplex of an aspherical two-dimensional complex is itself aspherical.

title: Zeeman Conjecture
description: Adding a one-cell to a contractible two-complex makes it collapsible.

title: Cabling Conjecture
description: Only cable knots admit Dehn surgeries yielding a reducible manifold.

title: Berge Conjecture
description: Classifies knots admitting Dehn surgeries that yield lens spaces.

title: Cosmetic Surgery Conjecture
description: No two distinct Dehn surgeries on a knot yield homeomorphic manifolds.

title: Cosmetic Crossing Conjecture
description: Changing a crossing in a knot projection cannot preserve its oriented type.

title: Nakanishi's 4-move Conjecture
description: Every knot can be unknotted using a sequence of four-moves.

title: Montesinos Conjecture
description: Classifies amphicheiral knots with specific branched double covers.

title: Smooth Schoenflies Problem
description: Does every embedded 3-sphere in 4-space bound a standard smooth 4-ball.

title: Halperin Conjecture
description: Relates rational cohomology of certain spaces to their minimal Sullivan models.

title: Moore's Conjecture
description: Relates the homotopy groups of finite complexes to their homology.

title: Freyd's Generating Hypothesis
description: Homotopy classes of stable maps are detected by their action on homology.

title: Kervaire Invariant One Problem
description: Determines the dimensions in which framed manifolds have Kervaire invariant one.

title: Triangulation Conjecture
description: Not all topological manifolds can be triangulated as simplicial complexes.

title: Hauptvermutung
description: Two triangulations of a space do not always share a common refinement.

title: Poincare Conjecture
description: Every simply connected closed 3-manifold is homeomorphic to the 3-sphere.

title: Geometrization Conjecture
description: Every closed 3-manifold can be decomposed into pieces with standard geometries.

title: Property P Conjecture
description: Non-trivial Dehn surgery on a non-trivial knot cannot yield simply-connected manifolds.

title: Smith Conjecture
description: Fixed point sets of periodic homeomorphisms of the 3-sphere cannot be knotted.

title: Milnor's Conjecture on Torus Knots
description: Determines the slice genus of torus knots.

title: Cobordism Hypothesis
description: Classifies fully extended topological quantum field theories via their value on points.

title: Tait Flyping Conjecture
description: Reduced alternating diagrams of the same knot are related by flypes.

title: Tait Alternating Knot Conjecture
description: Reduced alternating diagrams have the minimal number of crossings possible.

title: Hofer's Conjecture
description: Concerns the geometry of the group of Hamiltonian symplectomorphisms.

title: Nearby Lagrangian Conjecture
description: Closed exact Lagrangian submanifolds are Hamiltonian isotopic to the zero section.

title: Atiyah Conjecture on L2-Betti Numbers
description: The L2-Betti numbers of a finite complex with torsion-free group are integers.

title: Kaplansky Zero Divisor Conjecture
description: The group ring of a torsion-free group has no zero divisors.

title: Hopf Conjecture on Curvature
description: Compact even-dimensional manifolds with negative sectional curvature have positive Euler characteristic.

title: Chern's Conjecture on Affine Manifolds
description: The Euler characteristic of a compact affine manifold is always zero.

title: Singer Conjecture
description: The L2-cohomology of a closed aspherical manifold vanishes outside the middle dimension.

title: Gromov's Filling Area Conjecture
description: The hemisphere minimizes filling area among surfaces with a given boundary.

title: Borsuk's Conjecture
description: Can every set in n-dimensional space be divided into smaller diameter subsets.

title: Kneser-Poulsen Conjecture
description: Rearranging centers to decrease pairwise distances decreases union volume of balls.

title: Hirsch's Conjecture
description: Bounds the diameter of the graph of a convex polytope.

title: g-Conjecture
description: Characterizes the possible face numbers of simplicial spheres.

title: Charney-Davis Conjecture
description: Flag complexes of rational homology manifolds satisfy specific Euler characteristic bounds.

title: Galewski-Stern Conjecture
description: Concerns existence of a homology 3-sphere with specific Rokhlin invariant properties.

title: Lusternik-Schnirelmann Category of Spheres
description: Determines the minimal number of contractible open sets covering a manifold.

title: Milnor's Degree of Mappings Conjecture
description: Relates mapping degrees between manifolds to their fundamental groups.

title: Eilenberg-Zilber Theorem
description: Calculates the homology of the Cartesian product of two topological spaces.

title: Kashaev's Volume Conjecture
description: Relates the Kashaev invariant of a knot to its hyperbolic volume.

title: AJ Conjecture
description: Relates the A-polynomial of a knot to its colored Jones polynomials.

title: Slope Conjecture
description: The degree of colored Jones polynomials relates to boundary slopes of knots.

title: Strong Slope Conjecture
description: Refines the slope conjecture linking colored Jones polynomials to essential surfaces.

title: LMOV Conjecture
description: Relates Chern-Simons partition functions to BPS states in string theory.

title: Witten's Conjecture
description: Relates intersection numbers on moduli spaces of curves to the KdV equation.

title: Gopakumar-Vafa Conjecture
description: Expresses Gromov-Witten invariants in terms of integer BPS state counts.

title: Quantum Modularity Conjecture
description: Asserts quantum invariants of knots exhibit properties of modular forms.

title: HOMFLYPT Skein Module Finite Generation
description: The HOMFLYPT skein module of a compact 3-manifold is finitely generated.

title: Kauffman Bracket Skein Module Finite Generation
description: The Kauffman bracket skein module of any closed 3-manifold is finitely generated.

title: Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev Asymptotics
description: Describes the large level asymptotic behavior of quantum invariants of 3-manifolds.

title: AMU Conjecture
description: Pseudo-Anosov mapping classes act on skein modules with exponentially growing traces.

title: Turaev-Viro Invariants Asymptotics
description: Relates the asymptotic behavior of Turaev-Viro invariants to hyperbolic volumes.

title: Colored Jones Polynomial Stability
description: The coefficients of colored Jones polynomials of a knot eventually stabilize.

title: 3D-3D Correspondence
description: Relates supersymmetric gauge theories on 3-manifolds to topological invariants.

title: Khovanov Homology Detects the Unknot
description: Khovanov homology can distinguish the unknot from all other knots.

title: Combinatorial Definition of Rasmussen s-invariant
description: Seeking a purely combinatorial computation of the Rasmussen s-invariant without homology.

title: Kronheimer-Mrowka P-property
description: Instanton Floer homology detects the unknot.

title: Gordon-Luecke Theorem
description: Knots in the 3-sphere are determined by their complements.

title: Exotic Spheres in Dimension 4
description: Do exotic smooth structures exist on the 4-sphere.

title: Classification of Exotic R4s
description: Can we completely classify all uncountable exotic smooth structures on Euclidean 4-space.

title: Fintushel-Stern Knot Surgery
description: Knot surgery produces infinitely many exotic smooth structures on 4-manifolds.

title: Akbulut Corks Existence
description: Any two homeomorphic smooth simply connected 4-manifolds are related by cork twists.

title: Unknotting Number Computation
description: Finding an efficient algorithm to compute the minimal unknotting number of knots.

title: Fox-Artin Arc Problem
description: Classifies wild arcs in 3-dimensional space up to ambient isotopy.

title: Bing's Recognition Problem
description: Characterizing topological spaces that are homeomorphic to the standard 3-sphere.

title: Sullivan Conjecture
description: Relates the fixed point set of finite group actions to localized spaces.

title: Segal Conjecture
description: Relates the stable cohomotopy of classifying spaces to Burnside rings.

title: Ravenel's Conjectures
description: Describes the large-scale structure of the stable homotopy category of spheres.

title: Nilpotence Theorem
description: Characterizes nilpotent self-maps of finite CW complexes in stable homotopy theory.

title: Chromatic Convergence Theorem
description: The p-local sphere spectrum can be recovered from its chromatic localizations.

title: Ganea Conjecture
description: Adding a cell to a space increases its Lusternik-Schnirelmann category by one.

title: Smale's Paradox
description: A standard 2-sphere can be turned inside out smoothly without tearing.

title: Yau's Conjecture on Minimal Surfaces
description: Every closed Riemannian 3-manifold contains infinitely many smooth closed minimal surfaces.

title: Kadomtsev-Petviashvili Equation and Novikov
description: Solves the Schottky problem characterizing Jacobians using the KP equation.

title: Suslin's Conjecture
description: Relates algebraic K-theory of fields to their etale cohomology.

title: Lichtenbaum-Quillen Conjecture
description: Relates the algebraic K-theory of rings of integers to etale cohomology.

title: Beilinson-Lichtenbaum Conjecture
description: Asserts motivic cohomology complexes compute etale cohomology in specific degrees.

title: Gromov-Witten Invariants Integrality
description: Certain combinations of Gromov-Witten invariants are integers due to underlying geometry.

title: Ooguri-Vafa-Witten Invariants
description: Provides an integer invariant structure underlying colored Jones polynomials of knots.

title: Categorification of Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev Invariants
description: Finding a homology theory whose Euler characteristic recovers WRT quantum invariants.

title: Khovanov Homotopy Type Properties
description: Exploring stable homotopy refinements of Khovanov homology for knots and links.

title: Szabo's Geometric Spectral Sequence
description: Constructs a combinatorial spectral sequence from Khovanov homology to Heegaard Floer homology.

title: Manolescu's Floer Homotopy Theory
description: Extending Seiberg-Witten Floer homology to a stable homotopy type for 3-manifolds.

title: Gukov-Peacock-Putrov Conjecture
description: Predicts specific relations between homological blocks and quantum invariants.

title: Jones Polynomial Detecting the Unknot
description: Does the Jones polynomial distinguish the trivial knot from all other knots.

title: Fox Trapezoidal Conjecture
description: The coefficients of alternating knot polynomials always form a strictly trapezoidal sequence.

title: Hoste Conjecture
description: Alternating knot polynomial roots possess real parts greater than minus one.

title: Przytycki 3-Move Conjecture
description: Every classical link can be reduced to trivial components via three moves.

title: Virtual Haken Conjecture
description: Every irreducible closed three manifold has a finite cover containing essential surfaces.

title: Virtually Fibered Conjecture
description: Closed hyperbolic three manifolds have finite covers fibering over the circle.

title: Tunnel Number Additivity Conjecture
description: The tunnel number of a connected sum of knots is exactly additive.

title: Melvin-Morton-Rozansky Conjecture
description: The Alexander polynomial can be recovered from the colored Jones polynomial series.

title: Mutant Knot Unknotting Number Conjecture
description: Mutant knots always share the exact same minimum unknotting number.

title: Marino-Vafa Conjecture
description: Relates Chern Simons theory knot invariants to topological string theory partition functions.

title: Gusarov-Habiro Conjecture
description: Knots share identical finite type invariants only if they are grope equivalent.

title: Completeness of Vassiliev Invariants
description: Finite type invariants completely distinguish all non isotopic knots in three dimensions.

title: Arnold Chord Conjecture
description: Every Legendrian submanifold of a contact manifold admits a Reeb chord.

title: Putman Torelli Group Conjecture
description: The second rational homology of the Torelli group vanishes for high genus.

title: Gromov Bounded Cohomology Conjecture
description: The comparison map to singular cohomology is injective for all aspherical manifolds.

title: Square Peg Problem
description: Every continuous simple closed curve contains four points forming a geometric square.

title: Composite Knot Crossing Number Conjecture
description: The minimum crossing number strictly adds under the connected sum of knots.

title: Turaev Surface Words Conjecture
description: Virtual knots can be faithfully represented by equivalence classes of surface words.
